about: Ranked spending orders for raising team power, for a free player and for a paying one, at the account stages the sources discuss. Each step names the power source (power-sources.json) or package (packages.json), why it sits there and its sources. The order is the community's stated order. Every step carries a 'basis', what the step's place rests on: posted (the step itself is what a player measured, before and after), claimed (a figure stated without a measurement), unmeasured, or community (the step's place is the community's stated order, whatever figures its why cites for a neighbouring step or another account stage); 'basis_note' keeps the record's own wording where it says more, and where a step rests on inference it says so.

stages.label: New account to stage ~168 (the 'tutorial', rewards flow; tens of millions of power)

free.step: Push stages and keep a lineup that never loses a cookie on idle; claim everything (quests, missions, collection, pass free tracks).
free.why: Idle and quest rewards scale with stage; ~50,000 cutters come from quests by 168.

free.step: Level the lineup (free resets), Milk first.
Spend gold on Resolve, ATK first.
free.why: Early each level is a big share of power; a new player more than doubled power with Resolve, Stellar and gear.

free.step: Pull pickups to 5★; Crystals on cookies, not pets.
free.why: Stars open Stellar points; pets don't.

free.step: Stellar Link: unlocked 10-SP rolls to 60–70%.
Oven: open dough; mileage buys dough keys first.
Gnome Lab one step per node up to the specials; join a guild.
free.why: Specials (Sugar Flame, dice) speed everything; guild help and guild lab.

free.step: Plating: all to 5, then all to 10.
Arena every day for Fame.

paid.step: Unique 3-piece gear pack at oven 10 (6,000 KRW).
5.5 permanent membership (55,000 KRW) if staying 2+ months.
Cake Hound packs (1,500 / 12,000) and the monthly memberships.

stages.label: Stages 168–248 (rewards drop after 168; ~150M–1G before the 2026-09-23 easing)

free.step: Oven levels and gear (600M–1G is 'mostly oven-level gear').
free.why: The main driver in this band.

free.step: Plating to 15 with free Chocosteel (24 a day) and exchange Syrup; sword, bow, staff first.
free.why: At 150M with 15/13/13 plates, plates were the advised next step.

free.step: Stellar: hexagon at 6 points, octagon 91% at 8 (~1,900 SP).
Gnome Lab HP and ATK nodes; defense last.
Bank coin chests; open when a 35% line fails.
Exchanges: Syrup Metal > Chocosteel > Stellar > the rest; guild shop Tea Knight first.

paid.step: Weekly daily dungeon key set (6,000 KRW / $3.99) while floors are open.
paid.why: Dungeon floors drive oven, coins, stones, runes.

paid.step: Monthly gacha membership (15,000) with the 5.5 for pickups to 7–8★.

paid.why: The creator's pick for taking every open constellation to 80%+; it shapes open points, it doesn't open new ones.

free.step: Stellar: open constellation 7–8 points (stars) and shape them; 95% at 10 points on constellation 7.
Plating: weapons toward 15 then 20; Syrup for protection and restores.
Gnome Lab upper nodes (millions of stones).
Pure-power stage preset near a line; accuracy/focus ~900–1,000 is enough after the easing.
Fame daily.

paid.step: Stellar Link Pack Vol.1 or Vol.2.

free.step: Check your guild's research level: a research-13 guild is claimed at ~+20% account total power; leaving a guild dropped a pusher to the 15% cut.
free.basis_note: claimed for team power; posted only in account total (13G → ~10G on leaving, dc:81826)
free.why: Free to check; leaving cost one player ~23% of account total.

free.step: Build a pure-power stage preset (crit resistance and other padding lines, SSR rune lines that add power) and swap to it at a line.
Stellar: open and shape constellation-8 points up to 8-3, which free pulls reach; points past 8-3 (about 45 cookie stars to 8-6) need paid pulls.
free.basis_note: posted gain (+10% for the third point at 2G); reach inferred

free.step: Gnome Lab: HP 30% and the lower ATK nodes before ATK 30% (~50M stones).
free.basis_note: community order; the 2G → 4G reply credits research
free.why: 'Padded power is purely research' (dc:76290); special research 19 (ATK 30%) gave +2.3% at 3.4G (dc:82156). From 10-08 each new node costs ~1.01G stones (leak).

free.step: Plating: sword and bow toward 19–20 (most posted 4G accounts show sword 20–21, bow 19, rest 15).
free.basis_note: posted gain near 15 at 1.6G (~+1.5% a step, approximate); community order beyond

free.step: Oven levels toward the mid-30s for gear level.
free.basis_note: community order; one account's account of its path

free.step: Bank cookie EXP for levels 101–120 (cap 120 from 10-08); levels 79–100 get ~75% cheaper and refunded.
free.basis_note: community; the gain is inferred (+64% base stats at 120) or claimed (~+25% power at 119)
free.why: The next big free lever after 10-08; EXP and Crumble level gate it.

free.step: Fame; Resolve only from banked coins to cross a line.

paid.step: Rumble Special Pass (₩19,000) while it runs.
paid.why: A Bari pull ticket, Syrup and keys; the gallery calls it great value.

paid.step: Keep the weekly key set and Crumble Pass running.
paid.why: Stones for the lab, dough for the oven.

paid.step: Stellar Link packs to shape points that are already open (not for 100%).
paid.basis_note: community order; the costs are guide expectations
paid.why: Once points are open, SP is the cheapest way to add area (~550–1,900 SP expected per shape, nv:5693, dc:55570). It opens no points (dc:76290).

paid.step: Plate thanks packs for Syrup (all three while sold), weapons first; keep restore Syrup in hand.
paid.basis_note: posted gain near 15 (approximate) with table costs
paid.why: About +1.5% per 14→15 step at 1.6G for ~₩14,700 (inferred); most posted 4G accounts have weapon plates at 19–21.

paid.step: TSSR stars only for Stellar points or a deck need.
paid.why: About 289,000 KRW for 5★; a blessing-7 player at 3G+ said reaching 328 would take about 3,000,000 KRW more.

free.step: Enter the Rift early; Dimensional Energy grows while you are in it and inflates power there (~10G shown).
Re-roll the stage-padding rune lines for damage once in the Rift.

paid.step: Past 3–4G the levers players name are plating 16+ and TSSR stars; players at 3G+ report nothing cheaper left to raise.

ranked_at_2_2g.label: Ranked at about 2.2G

free.basis_note: posted up to 8-3; paid past it
nothing left at 100 until 10-08; then levels 101–120 (gain claimed or inferred)

ranked_at_2_2g.note: The community's orders at ~2.2G, not rankings by power per unit. Only Stellar (to 8-3) and plating near 15 have posted gains; guild and padding lead as free checks.
